selection_caveat: The published article was known at source-gate freeze and reports strong spatial/temporal interaction turnover and partner switching. Therefore candidate-system selection is not outcome-blind with respect to generic network dynamics. No izu-core Shannon-diversity or plant-niche-overlap target has been computed for this system, and this gate does not calculate either metric.

source_policy.public_access_rule: Enumerate only files returned by the public Figshare article metadata. Download only each returned public download_url; do not guess filenames or alternate storage paths.
source_policy.checksum_rule: Record Figshare supplied/computed MD5 when present and locally compute SHA256 for every recovered file. A supplied/computed MD5 mismatch or local payload mismatch is a hard failure.

schema_audit.text_tables: For CSV/TSV/TXT files record delimiter, row/column count, header names and up to five non-numeric identifier examples; do not aggregate numeric interaction values.
schema_audit.excel: For XLS/XLSX record workbook sheets, dimensions and header rows only; do not calculate network metrics.
schema_audit.archives: List member names, sizes and extensions; inspect tabular member schemas without computing target metrics.
schema_audit.r_objects: Record file type/bytes/checksum only in the initial gate unless a separate schema-only reader is required. Do not inspect derived network metric objects for candidate selection.

required_fields_or_reconstructable_equiv: study site or spatial local-context identifier
quantitative interaction weight or reconstructable visit count
admission_requirements.required_nested_structure: At least three quantitative local networks within Menorca under a common source protocol, with local units nested within one island system.
admission_requirements.primary_weight_preference: Use the source-native quantitative interaction frequency/count family used to construct the published multilayer interactions. Do not derive weights from abundance-only files.
admission_requirements.blocked_rule: If the public Figshare files do not expose enough source-native interaction information to reconstruct at least three quantitative local networks, record the source gate as blocked and do not calculate Shannon/overlap.

prohibited_before_source_admission: rank Menorca layers by v5 fit
select only habitats/months with large published turnover
drop taxa or sampling units by expected model agreement
treat published connectance/nestedness/selectivity values as the frozen v5 targets
next_gate: If source admission succeeds, freeze the exact reconstructed local-network unit, target estimands, weighting family and held-out v5 decision rule from source schema before calculating Shannon or plant niche overlap.
claim_boundary: This is source/schema admission only. It cannot support or falsify v5 and it does not turn Menorca sites, habitats or months into independent archipelagos.
